title: Sampling and Statistics
preview: Biased and unbiased samples, comparing populations using measures of center and spread, and visual overlap of distributions.
description: Indiana standards 7.DSP.1, 7.DSP.2, 7.DSP.3. Students reason about sampling validity and draw comparative inferences across two populations.

sections.label: 11-1 Biased and Unbiased Samples
sections.description: Recognise representative samples and the role of random sampling.

sections.label: 11-2 Make Predictions
sections.description: Use samples to make predictions about a population.

sections.label: 11-3 Generate Multiple Samples
sections.description: Use mean and median, range, IQR, and MAD to compare random samples.

sections.label: 11-4 Compare Two Populations
sections.description: Draw inferences about two populations from their samples.

sections.label: 11-5 Assess Visual Overlap
sections.description: Compare distributions on line plots or box plots; describe how outliers shift centre and spread.
